The activity asks for automated monitoring to flag when spending with certified minority-owned and women-owned suppliers falls below contractual diversity targets, segmented by business unit and fiscal quarter. This requires:

1. Supplier diversity spend tracking and analytics
2. Contractual target management and comparison
3. Spending segmentation by business unit and fiscal period
4. Automated flagging/alerting on variance

None of the candidates fulfill this requirement:
- The APIs (Material Receipt, Material/Vendor Master Data, Material/Vendor Procurement Data) handle material and vendor master data but lack supplier diversity spend analytics and diversity target tracking capabilities
- The agents (Engineering Change, Production Change Orchestrator, Asset Lifecycle) focus on engineering changes and production coordination, not supplier diversity monitoring
- The data products focus on engineering change impact, workforce readiness, and production transition capability—not supplier diversity spend analytics or diversity target management

This activity requires a specialized spend analytics or supplier diversity management capability that the knowledge-graph walk did not surface.
